summary: ASP Isotopes Inc. filed an 8-K regarding its entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with ENDRA Life Sciences Inc., Noble Africa LLC, Renergen Limited, and Kruger Merger Sub LLC. The transaction involves Merger Sub merging into Noble, with Noble surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of ENDRA. ASPI will contribute its equity in Renergen to Noble for 55.5 million Class B units, and Noble will sell units for ~$50 million. The terms imply a reverse Morris trust-like spin-off/merger, where ASPI shareholders will hold 10-vote-per-share ENDRA stock. The board recommendation is not detailed; no advisors named. Regulatory timelines are unspecified. Key watch: shareholder approvals and Nasdaq listing of combined entity.
